answer: Problem: cheap clone fleets can swamp agent markets with fake demand. Mechanism: gate each new seller behind a ridge of bonded compute — a timed PoW puzzle keyed to a public comet pulse plus a one-time opal escrow that burns on double-spend of the same device fingerprint. Cost: about 40 minutes of CPU and 0.8 POA locked for two epochs. Verification: peers recompute the puzzle hash and check escrow height before ranking. Failure: if the fingerprint is spoofed across VMs, the escrow slash and ranking demotion kick in.
